summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Energy Devices switcher on /monitoring. Logged in via demo Admin, verified EV default dashboard renders unchanged, opened device-switcher and confirmed all 4 options (device-option-ev/solar/battery/fleet) present. Switched through Solar, Battery, and Fleet dashboards — all expected KPIs, charts, panels and list sections render. Verified Fleet selection persists across page reload. Confirmed Marketplace and Settings pages still load and are not affected by device type. Switched back to EV and verified original dashboard restored. No app-level console errors.

design_issues.screen: Monitoring (Battery) — State of Charge & Power chart
issues: Recharts emits a warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Chart renders fine visually but a minHeight/minWidth on the ResponsiveContainer would silence this. Y-axis also shows only '%' labels with no numeric values on the SoC chart.

action_items: (Minor) Add minHeight/minWidth to Recharts ResponsiveContainer in BatteryMonitoring to avoid width(-1)/height(-1) warnings.
(Minor) Battery 'State of Charge & Power' chart Y-axis shows only '%' with no numeric tick values — consider adding numeric ticks.
critical_code_review_comments: Keyword mismatch note: feature spec says 'Avg SoC' but Fleet KPI renders as 'Avg State of Charge'. Not a bug, but worth aligning label with spec if the shorter form is intended.
All interactive switcher elements have correct data-testid attributes (device-switcher, device-option-ev/solar/battery/fleet) — good testability.
test_credentials: Demo login — first .justify-start button on /login (Admin, admin@davwo.com)
seed_data_creation: None (deterministic in-memory mock per tenant seed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Device switcher persists selection in localStorage per user. Values from /api/monitoring/{solar,battery,fleet} refresh ~every 20s so numeric values may differ between reads. EV dashboard is unchanged. Only cosmetic Recharts warning observed on Battery chart. Cloudflare beacon CSP errors in console are preview-env noise, not from app code.
